name: taskei-mock
description: Eval-only agent: runs MCP-backed skills (e.g. taskei-issue-creator) against the mock builder-mcp server (evals/mocks/builder-mcp) instead of the real Taskei/Maxis backend. The analogue of prepending evals/mocks to PATH for the gh/git CLI mocks. The relative command path resolves from the eval workspace cwd (evals/), which is where the Kiro provider runs promptfoo; kiro-cli does NOT expand ${VAR} in agent args, so the path must be literal/relative, not an env var.
